items.name: Caltech Fall 2015

venue.name: [California Institute of Technology](http://www.caltech.edu/)
venue.details: Annenberg Center, room 105. See website for more details.

items.information: The cost of registration is $10 if you are doing four or fewer events, and $20 if you are doing five or more events. If you do not pre-register online by Nov 14th, the fee will be doubled. There is a 100-person competitor limit. If you are a Caltech student, just show your student ID and the registration fee will be waived. $1 per competitor goes to the WCA.

items.name: Manhasset Fall 2015

venue.name: Manhasset High School
venue.details: Please enter the school at the rear through the arches. The registration table will be just inside the cafeteria.

items.information: Manhasset Fall 2015 is open to all competitors! Be sure to pre-register.

items.name: PDX Cubing Beta 2015
items.information: The registration is $10 per competitor. There is a 90 competitor limit, so please register soon if you plan on attending. Note that parking in the area is limited, so consider carpooling or local transit to make your commute easier.

items.name: River Hill Fall 2015

venue.name: [River Hill High School](http://www2.hcpss.org/rhhs)
venue.details: Competition is in the cafeteria of the school.

items.information: The registration is $15 base fee for 3x3 and an additional $1 per extra event. Registration at the door may or may not be an option. All competitors will pay at the door and please be sure to bring exact change. Spectators will be admitted for free.

items.information: The number of competitor is limited to 30 due room's size. Registration fee is 10 CHF.
